summary:
Revised implementation plan incorporating user refinements:
1. Procedural 128x128 pure-white enemy texture atlas with sprite.tint and preserved enemyPools structure.
2. Relative LOD distance threshold based on playerAttackRadius + 90px.
3. Fully pre-warmed 400-sprite projectile pool on init with zero runtime growth.
4. Multi-tier adaptive governor (18.5ms / 15.0ms) coupled to enemy LOD staggering.
5. Strict preservation of 100% visual identity and geometry across all 15 enemy shapes and bosses.
6. Sequential 6-stage implementation workflow with clear testing checkpoints.
